formulas.description: Derives Open or Fixed from the Update Dates End Date. A blank End Date is Open.
formulas.name: UpdateDatesDerivedRecurringTypeFormula
UpdateDatesPlannedInstallmentsFormula
formulas.expression: IF({!UpdateDatesDerivedRecurringTypeFormula} <> "Fixed", NULL, IF(ISBLANK({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) || {!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate} > {!UpdateDatesEndDate}, 0, CASE(TEXT({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.TransactionPeriod}), "Daily", FLOOR(({!UpdateDatesEndDate} - {!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate}) / BLANKVALUE({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.TransactionInterval}, 1)) + 1, "Weekly", FLOOR(({!UpdateDatesEndDate} - {!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate}) / (7 * BLANKVALUE({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.TransactionInterval}, 1))) + 1, "Monthly", FLOOR((((YEAR({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) - YEAR({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate})) * 12) + (MONTH({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) - MONTH({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate})) - IF(DAY({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) < DAY({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate}), 1, 0)) / BLANKVALUE({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.TransactionInterval}, 1)) + 1, "Yearly", FLOOR((((YEAR({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) - YEAR({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate})) * 12) + (MONTH({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) - MONTH({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate})) - IF(DAY({!UpdateDatesEndDate}) < DAY({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.StartDate}), 1, 0)) / (12 * BLANKVALUE({!UpdateDatesSelectSchdDataTable.firstSelectedRow.TransactionInterval}, 1))) + 1, 1)))
